cues.en: Instructor: You do not need to be a mathematics expert in order to do well at this course.
cues.zh: 要學好這門課，不需要成為數學專家。

cues.en: You don't need to have a degree in math, you don't need to have taken advanced university level courses in mathematics in order to succeed and learn everything
cues.zh: 不需要數學學位，也不需要修過大學進階數學課，就能成功學會，

cues.en: about statistics from this course.
cues.zh: 這門課的所有統計內容。

cues.en: However, there are some basic mathematical principles that you need to know.
cues.zh: 不過，有些基本數學原理需要知道。

cues.en: And in this section of the course, I'm gonna go through those principles a bit briskly.
cues.zh: 這一節，我會稍微快速地介紹這些原理。

cues.en: I hope most of this is a reminder for you rather than something totally new that you haven't encountered before.
cues.zh: 希望其中大多數是幫你複習，而非從未接觸過的全新內容。

cues.en: So you do need to know basic arithmetic.
cues.zh: 你確實需要懂基本算術。

cues.en: I assume that you can interpret these symbols, and you can evaluate these expressions.
cues.zh: 我假設你能解讀這些符號，並計算這些算式。

cues.en: You also need to know some basic algebra like substitutions, so, you know, substituting x for seven here.
cues.zh: 也需要懂基本代數，例如代入，像這裡用 7 代入 x。

cues.en: And you also need to know how to solve for particular variables.
cues.zh: 也要知道如何解出特定變數。

cues.en: So for example, if I would ask you to solve this equation for x, you would need to know how to do that.
cues.zh: 例如，如果要求你由這個方程式解出 x，就需要知道怎麼做。

cues.en: So you know, divide both sides of the equation by three, and then divide both sides of the equation by 4 + y.
cues.zh: 把等號兩邊除以 3，再把兩邊除以 4+y。

cues.en: And then you isolate x on the left hand side, and have whatever else is on the right hand side.
cues.zh: 接著在左邊單獨留下 x，其他項都在右邊。

cues.en: Now, you don't need to do that here, but just so you know how to solve that kind of mathematical operation.
cues.zh: 這裡不用實際做，只要知道如何處理這類數學運算。

cues.en: There's also exponents, that's when you see a smaller cuter number that is super scripted, so it's above and to the right of what's called the base number.
cues.zh: 還有指數，就是看到一個比較小、可愛的數字，以上標寫在所謂底數的右上方。

cues.en: And that just means to repeat multiplication some number of times.
cues.zh: 它代表重複乘法若干次。

cues.en: So 3 to the power of 2, or 3 squared is 3 times 3, so we have the threes twice because there's a two here.
cues.zh: 所以 3 的 2 次方，也就是 3 平方，是 3 乘 3。因為這裡是 2，所以有兩個 3。

cues.en: So 3 to the power of 4 is 3 times, 3 times 3 times 3.
cues.zh: 3 的 4 次方，就是 3 乘 3 乘 3 乘 3。

cues.en: Then there's something called the law of exponents, which sounds really fancy and dramatic, but it simply means that if you are multiplying two numbers
cues.zh: 接著有個叫做指數律的東西，聽起來很華麗、很戲劇化，但意思只是，如果把兩個帶有指數的數相乘，

cues.en: that have exponents in them, then if the bases are the same, like the three and the three, then you can add the exponents.
cues.zh: 而且底數相同，例如 3 和 3，就能把指數相加。

cues.en: So 3 to the power of 2 times 3 to the power of 4 equals 3 to the power of the combination of 2 + 4,
cues.zh: 所以 3 的 2 次方，乘上 3 的 4 次方，等於 3 的 2+4 次方，

cues.en: so that's just six threes written out.
cues.zh: 寫出來，就是六個 3 相乘。

cues.en: Now, this only works when the base is the same.
cues.zh: 這只有在底數相同時才成立。

cues.en: So here we have 3 squared times 4 cubed, and it's not possible to combine the two and the three here because the bases are different.
cues.zh: 這裡是 3 平方乘 4 立方，不能把 2 和 3 合併，因為底數不同。

cues.en: Now, an important use of exponents is putting a negative sign in the exponent, and that's often used as a convenient mathematical shorthand
cues.zh: 指數的一個重要用法，是在指數中放負號，這常作為方便的數學簡寫，

cues.en: for indicating a fraction.
cues.zh: 用來表示分數。

cues.en: So when you see a negative sign in the exponent, then you take the reciprocal of the base.
cues.zh: 所以在指數看到負號，就取底數的倒數。

cues.en: So n to the power of -1 means 1 divided by n.
cues.zh: n 的 −1 次方，代表 1 除以 n。

cues.en: So people often use this kind of shorthand if they basically just wanna save some vertical real estate, here you can see that this is more compact vertically,
cues.zh: 人們常用這種簡寫，主要是為了節省垂直空間。可以看到，這種寫法在垂直方向更緊湊，

cues.en: and this takes up a larger space.
cues.zh: 而這種寫法占的空間比較大。

cues.en: So when there's equations that are written in the middle of text, or if there's a lot of space, or there isn't a lot of space on the screen, then people will use this notation, I use this quite often.
cues.zh: 所以方程式寫在文字中間，或畫面空間多、空間不足時，人們會用這種記法。我也經常使用。

cues.en: More generally, n to the power of -a is the same thing as 1 divided by n to the power of a.
cues.zh: 更一般地，n 的 −a 次方，等同於 1 除以 n 的 a 次方。

cues.en: So you still have to preserve the exponent here, implicitly there's a one over here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡還是要保留指數，這裡隱含一個 1。

cues.en: And the minus sign just means that you take the reciprocal of this number and then you get rid of the minus sign, of course.
cues.zh: 負號只是代表取這個數的倒數，當然，之後就去掉負號。

cues.en: So that was a quick reminder of the arithmetic, the basic algebra, solving for variables, and exponents that you'll need to know
cues.zh: 這是快速複習算術、基本代數、解變數與指數，這些是你需要知道的，

cues.en: for the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 以便學習課程剩餘內容。

cues.en: I think the most important concept here is that when there's a negative sign in the exponent, you take the reciprocal of the number.
cues.zh: 這裡最重要的概念，是指數有負號時，就取這個數的倒數。
